name: mirage
text: The Odds API audit: it is last in line and today's spend is small. Since 00:00 UTC the engine has spent 18 credits on it, all on NCAAF as a gap-fill (a league no better feed answered), and 0 credits on the other leagues it checked. The heavy numbers you saw are the month's total across your free keys (500 credits each). Most of that was spent Oct 16-18, before the v1.0.26 pacing fix cut gap-fills from every 30 min to every 3 h. Several keys are already used up for the month. That use has a reason and is already paced, so I'm making no change. The hourly 'Spend:' line in the engine log keeps counting by league. The 'build those items' message: I'm taking that as the open CH57 pieces (bids CLV and the grader keeping every close). Starting now.
